parole.significato: die, dice (polyhedron used in game of chance)
parole.testo: From Byzantine Greek ζάριν (zárin), from ἀζάριον (azárion), from Arabic اَلزَّهْر (az-zahr, “the dice”). Cognate with English hazard.
